//: Merge into ~/.cursor/hooks.json to enable hooks/cursor/session-scratchpad.sh. Cursor loads user-level hooks from ~/.cursor/hooks.json and runs `command` directly (no shell), so a leading `~` is NOT expanded — `command` must be a real absolute path to the installed hook (symlinked into ~/.cursor/hooks/). Replace the placeholder below with your home dir, e.g. /Users/you/.cursor/hooks/session-scratchpad.sh; hooks/install-multi-agent-hooks.sh writes it for you. CAVEAT: the Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) currently fires only before/afterShellExecution — sessionStart fires in the Cursor IDE, so this hook is effectively IDE-only until the CLI gains sessionStart support.
